headline: Coupang Chairman Bom Suk Kim: 'Most customers have returned… profitability to recover next year'
summary: Coupang Inc. reported an operating loss of 835 billion won in the second quarter, swinging from a profit a year earlier. Its chairman said most customers have returned and profitability should recover next year.
why: Coupang is a South Korean e-commerce platform operator and one of the country's largest online retailers, listed in the United States. Its quarterly results are a key gauge of Korean online retail demand.
